basic_info.description: Step into the ultimate urban oasis at 3345 17th St #5, a top-floor loft in the heart of the Inner Mission. This 1 bedroom / 1.5 bathroom home features welcoming social spaces downstairs and a private escape upstairs, making it the perfect base for adventure across the city. Soaring ceilings and north-facing windows fill the living/dining area with light. This space is perfect for WFH, relaxing, or hosting. The sleek kitchen features granite counters, stainless steel appliances & a breakfast bar. Entry & kitchen closets, in-unit laundry, and a half bath add effortless functionality. Upstairs, the lofted bedroom offers retreat, a full ensuite bath, a walk-in closet, & a back door leading to the shared rooftop decksip your morning coffee or evening tea with stunning 360-degree views. This elevator building also includes 1-car side-by-side garage parking. But with a 99 Walk Score, 96 Transit Score & 100 Bike Score, you may leave the car at home! The Mission's vibrant food, nightlife, and culture are right outside - including 150 restaurants, bars & cafs representing the cuisines of 30+ nations within 3 blocks. The best of the city is at your fingertips - but when it's time to recharge, there's no place like home at 3345 17th St #5.
